### 1. The "Forward P/E" Fallacy in a 5% Yield World
You dismissed the 53x Trailing P/E and leaned on the 26.96 Forward P/E as if it’s a security blanket. You called the backlog a "fortress." I call it a liability. In an era of high interest rates and persistent inflation, long-term, fixed-price contracts are dangerous. If they hit a supply chain snag or a localized permitting disaster—which are becoming increasingly common—that margin disappears, and with it, your earnings growth narrative. ### 3. Technicals Don't Lie—They Tell the Truth

These aren't just lines on a chart; they are the overhead ceilings created by institutional investors who have been net sellers, taking profits after a 392% run.
